limitations.text: Candidates are exploratory sequences. Planting season, soil suitability, water and climate constraints must be checked before recommendation.
This is a preliminary screening, not a complete agronomic suitability assessment.

The temperature passed to crop suitability screening is M1's ensemble-mean annual mean air temperature for the selected scenario and year: an annual regional projection, not a growing-season or field measurement.
Precipitation flux (kg m-2 s-1) is converted to daily millimetres by multiplying by 86,400, then summed annually.
Temperature is converted from Kelvin to degrees Celsius.
Ensemble spread is the difference between the highest and lowest contributing model values; it is not a probability interval.
The nearest 0.25-degree grid cell represents regional climate conditions, not an exact field-level forecast.
Model outputs are sampled at their nearest grid cells. They are regional projections, not field-level forecasts.
M4 explains results produced by other CropCompass modules. It does not establish agronomic suitability, predict yields or quantify soil benefits.
